CALLS.label: calls
CALLS.purpose: Connects statically observed program calls across the bounded COBOL and PL/I intake.

CONTAINS.label: contains
CONTAINS.purpose: Connects bounded HLASM programs, IMS definitions, and JCL jobs or procedures to their statically observed members.

DECLARES.label: declares
DECLARES.purpose: Records the typed entities deterministically declared by an approved source file.

EXECUTES.label: executes
EXECUTES.purpose: Connects a JCL EXEC statement to a declared program or bounded external executable.

HAS_COLUMN.label: has column
HAS_COLUMN.purpose: Connects a Db2 table to a statically parsed column definition.

HAS_CONSTRAINT.label: has constraint
HAS_CONSTRAINT.purpose: Connects a Db2 table to a statically parsed primary-key constraint.

BRANCHES_TO.label: branches to
BRANCHES_TO.purpose: Connects a bounded HLASM branch instruction to a symbol declared in the same approved source file.

HAS_COMPONENT.label: has component
HAS_COMPONENT.purpose: Connects a VSAM cluster definition to its statically observed data and index components.

HAS_DATASET_GROUP.label: has dataset group
HAS_DATASET_GROUP.purpose: Connects an IMS DBD to a statically observed DATASET macro.

HAS_FIELD.label: has field
HAS_FIELD.purpose: Connects an IMS segment to a statically observed FIELD macro.

INDEXES.label: indexes
INDEXES.purpose: Connects a Db2 index definition to its target table.

ISSUES_SQL.label: issues SQL
ISSUES_SQL.purpose: Connects a supported source program to a statically observed embedded SQL statement.

PARENT_OF.direction: parent IMS segment to child segment
PARENT_OF.label: parent of
PARENT_OF.purpose: Records the IMS segment hierarchy declared by PARENT attributes in a DBD.

READS_TABLE.label: reads table
READS_TABLE.purpose: Records a statically observed SELECT against a Db2 table.

RESOLVES_TO.label: resolves to
RESOLVES_TO.purpose: Resolves a configured CICS program resource to a declared source program when present.

STARTS_PROGRAM.label: starts program
STARTS_PROGRAM.purpose: Connects an approved CICS configuration export to its configured program resource.

SENSITIVE_TO.label: sensitive to
SENSITIVE_TO.purpose: Connects an IMS PCB to a segment named by a statically observed SENSEG macro.

TARGETS.label: targets
TARGETS.purpose: Connects VSAM alternate-index and path catalog definitions to their statically named targets.

USES_DBD.label: uses DBD
USES_DBD.purpose: Connects a PCB DBDNAME reference to a DBD present in the approved intake.

USES_COPYBOOK.label: uses copybook
USES_COPYBOOK.purpose: Connects a COBOL COPY statement to a copybook present in the approved intake.

WRITES_TABLE.label: writes table
WRITES_TABLE.purpose: Records a statically observed INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE against a Db2 table.
